First-party cross-repo reusables stay at @main: never pin or bump Thilagan-Digital/* refs (ADR-2026-PLATFORM-OPS-01 §2.4, ADR-2026-PLATFORM-OPS-02 §2.4). Kept LAST so it overrides the pinDigests and automerge rules above. minimumReleaseAge is inert on a disabled rule; it is here because semgrep's renovate-missing-minimum-release-age rule wants one per package-selecting rule
